title.original: WAREX: Web Agent Reliability Evaluation on Existing Benchmarks
title.zh: WAREX：对现有基准的Web 智能体可靠性评估
title.en: WAREX: Web Agent Reliability Evaluation on Existing Benchmarks

inclusion_reason.zh: WAREX 是可叠加到现有 Web 基准的网络、服务和页面故障注入层，用于系统化测量生产可靠性。
inclusion_reason.en: WAREX is a network, service, and page-fault injection layer reusable atop existing web benchmarks for systematic production-reliability measurement.

abstract.zh: WAREX 为现有 Web Agent 基准注入网络、HTTPS、客户端/服务端故障和页面攻击变化，以测量受控环境分数之外的可靠性。
abstract.en: WAREX injects network, HTTPS, client/server failures, and hostile page variations into existing web-agent benchmarks to measure reliability beyond controlled-environment scores.

problem.zh: 容器化稳定网站几乎不呈现真实网络波动、服务故障、页面更新和恶意弹窗，因而把一次成功误当作可部署可靠性。
problem.en: Stable containerized sites omit real network variation, service failures, page changes, and malicious pop-ups, so one-run success is mistaken for deployable reliability.

approach.zh: 框架在 WebArena、WebVoyager 和 REAL 的既有任务上系统施加多源故障与网页扰动，再比较 Agent 的成功率退化。
approach.en: The framework overlays controlled multi-source faults and web perturbations on tasks from WebArena, WebVoyager, and REAL and measures degradation.

system_design.zh: WAREX 作为故障代理位于 Agent 与浏览器/网络/站点之间，调度可复现的异常场景并复用原基准任务与验证器。
system_design.en: WAREX acts as a fault proxy between agent and browser, network, and site, scheduling reproducible anomalies while reusing original tasks and evaluators.

key_results.zh: 加入 WAREX 后，多种先进 Web Agent 的任务成功率明显下滑，暴露控制环境排行榜未体现的脆弱性。
key_results.en: Adding WAREX substantially lowers success for advanced web agents, exposing fragility hidden by controlled-environment leaderboards.

limitations.zh: 注入故障只是现实失效的样本，强度和组合未必匹配生产分布；复用原验证器也继承其奖励与任务缺陷。
limitations.en: Injected faults sample only part of production failure distributions, and reusing original evaluators inherits their task and reward shortcomings.

baselines: Original benchmark environments without WAREX faults

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
